note: Single source of truth for the Arthome taxonomy, read by every surface. Structure only: every entry carries an i18n key whose copy lives in i18n/taxonomy.json. Four layers — universe (navigation only), discipline (mandatory, unique, closed), subgenre (0..n, closed), tag (0..n, flat and open) — plus structured attributes that sit OUTSIDE the taxonomy because a wheelchair filter must never depend on someone remembering a tag.

model.universe: Navigation only, never a taxonomic level. Shown where a long list needs structuring — section headings on the categories page, filter chips in search — never as a top-level tab.
model.discipline: Mandatory, unique, closed vocabulary. A discipline is a FORM — never a language, an era or a country. Secondary disciplines may exist internally.
model.subgenre: Optional, multiple, closed vocabulary. What the work IS artistically. A subgenre enters the list only if it has notable artists and a real stage presence in France; anything finer is a tag.
model.tag: Optional, multiple, one flat canonical list. HOW, WHERE, FOR WHOM and UNDER WHAT CONDITIONS the work is seen. Carried by the date as much as by the show.
model.attribute: Objective data the application must be able to query reliably. Rendered as pills, stored as fields.
model.noScenes: There is no "Rap FR": that is discipline = rap crossed with artist.country = FR or language = fr. The search engine translates; the taxonomy stays clean.
model.duplicateLabels: A label may appear in two disciplines. music.flamenco and dance.flamenco are two concepts, not one repeated identifier.
model.rank: Ordre éditorial de présentation, du plus grand public au plus pointu, familles mêlées. Une surface qui liste les disciplines suit ce rang ; elle ne le recalcule pas.

tagCategories.FORM: Stage form — mime, trapeze, shadow theatre.
tagCategories.FORMAT: How it is performed — solo, DJ set, concert version, film concert.
tagCategories.CONTEXT: When, where, in what setting — premiere, open air, church, tour.
tagCategories.AUDIENCE: Editorial complement to the minimumAge attribute.
tagCategories.EDITORIAL: Subjective descriptor. Feeds recommendation and editorial, never factual filtering.

tagPolicy.flat: One flat canonical list. The internal category creates no visible level: it exists only to suggest well — never offer a venue tag on an artist sheet, never offer blackgaze because a hall used it once.
tagPolicy.identity: slug is the stable key and is never displayed; the label is the display copy; aliases are absorbed on input; usageCount drives sorting and merging.
tagPolicy.custom: Artists and venues may create free tags from the studio. On input, match against existing tags and their aliases and suggest the match before creating.
tagPolicy.noThreshold: On a sheet, every tag is a clickable pill whatever its volume — that is lateral navigation. A global list of tags sorts by frequency and cuts the tail.
tagPolicy.ownership: A tag sits on the date as readily as on the show: the same show may be staged one night and given in concert version the next.
tagPolicy.suggestedBy: Subgenre suggests style tags; the artist brings its own; the venue suggests place tags; the date generates premiere / final / creation; the editor adds or removes freely.
